name: Demo oyster batch (simulated)
substrate_details: 2 kg hydrated straw, 10 % grain spawn rate, 5 L bucket with 12 mm side holes

profile.name: Oyster – straw/sawdust (reference)
profile.cultivation_method: Pasteurised straw or supplemented sawdust, bag/bucket, top-fruiting or side-fruiting
profile.source_notes: Typical ranges compiled from general cultivation literature. Not validated for your strain, substrate or chamber – verify and adjust. Note: the DHT11 is only rated to ~90 % RH and 0–50 °C; readings above 90 % RH should be treated as approximate.

stages.name: Substrate preparation
stages.description: Hydrate, pasteurise or sterilise substrate; cool before inoculation.
stages.transition_criteria: Substrate cooled to below 30 °C and ready for inoculation.

stages.name: Inoculation
stages.description: Spawn mixed through substrate under clean conditions.

stages.name: Incubation & colonisation
stages.description: Dark, warm, stable. Container retains moisture so ambient RH is less critical.
observable_signs: White mycelium spreading from spawn points
stages.transition_criteria: Substrate fully colonised (white throughout), no green/black patches.

stages.name: Primordia formation (pinning)
stages.description: Lower temperature, high humidity, fresh air and indirect light trigger pins.
stages.transition_criteria: Visible pin clusters at the fruiting openings (grower confirmation).

stages.name: Fruiting-body development
stages.description: Caps expand rapidly; strong fresh-air exchange prevents long stems and small caps.
observable_signs: Stems short and caps broad with good airflow
stages.transition_criteria: Cap edges begin to flatten; largest caps near harvest size.

stages.name: Harvest readiness
stages.description: Harvest just before caps flatten/upturn and before heavy spore release.
observable_signs: Cap edges still slightly curled downward
stages.transition_criteria: Grower judges cluster ready and harvests.

stages.name: Harvest
stages.description: Cut cluster at the base; weigh and record yield.

stages.name: Post-harvest evaluation / rest
stages.description: Evaluate yield and quality; rest the block before the next flush.
stages.transition_criteria: Second flush pins appear or block is retired.

notes: Demo batch created automatically. All sensor data linked to this batch is SIMULATED.

observations.note: First tiny pin clusters forming at two of the side holes.
Fully white block; opened side holes and switched to pinning targets.
Mycelium visible around spawn grains, roughly 30 % of visible surface.

stage_events.note: Bucket sealed and placed in the chamber.
Substrate fully colonised; fruiting conditions started (lower temperature, FAE cycle, high humidity).
